summary: Seer, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing receipt and rejection of a further revised unsolicited non-binding proposal from the Radoff-JEC Group to acquire all outstanding Class A common shares for $2.40 per share in cash plus a contingent value right. The board unanimously rejected the proposal, determining it significantly undervalues the company and is below the sum of its cash and investments. Perella Weinberg Partners serves as financial advisor, Wilson Sonsini as legal counsel. The proposal is non-binding and highly contingent; watch for potential increased offer or activist escalation.
